concerns.classification: version-matched upstream advisory; repository exposure not demonstrated
concerns.notes: Confirmed upstream affected-version match, not a new confirmed repository defect. Keep dev server/API/standalone mocking exposure out of scope until a separately authorized maintenance decision; current server runtime has no third-party npm imports.

scan.kind: read-only literal specifier scan; not execution or complete module graph proof

nodeSources.conclusion: Node 22 and 24 listed as LTS at review; package engines >=22 does not identify an installed patch or integrity.
Official July security release points to patched Node 24.18.1. Repository unit configuration 24.19.0 is numerically later; no live binary/provenance validation done.
Official matching release exists, dated 2026-08-03. A configured path is not proof of deployed binary contents.
Later LTS release dated 2026-09-08 exists and updates OpenSSL/Undici. Version age alone is not a confirmed exploitable repository issue.

cocosSources.conclusion: Official 3.8.8 release entry exists; creator.version is a project/editor declaration, not cryptographic engine provenance.
Version-tagged runtime engine top-level license is MIT. This does not inventory all bundled third-party components, editor licensing, assets or shipped notices.
Editor permits built-in or custom engine paths; project declaration alone cannot distinguish custom build.

npmBulk.status: No captured HTTP response; own audit process observed in TCP SYN_SENT after 87 seconds and terminated; no retry

githubBatch.status: Web tool rejected both as non-retryable URL safety errors; no retry

validation.fileWrites: Only dependency-boundaries-40 audit artifacts via apply_patch
validation.initialOnlineProbeIssue: https.request socket timeout did not bound connection setup. Stopped own audit PID and added absolute 20s deadline plus skip-after-advisory-failure; not a product issue and revised online path was not retried.

limitations: Full current advisory coverage of all 69 name/version pairs is not verified. No empty response, zero-CVE, malware-free or production-security clearance is claimed.
23 non-host optional native packages have no local package.json/license evidence. Their licenses and upstream registry integrity remain unverified; no packages were installed to fill this gap.

69 lock SHA512 integrity strings and the equality of two installed pnpm lock copies do not authenticate extracted package bytes, upstream tarballs, signatures or provenance. Registry metadata/tarball comparison was not completed.

License values are metadata declarations. Notices are hashed, not legal approval; TypeScript has a separate ThirdPartyNoticeText.txt. @rolldown/binding-darwin-arm64 and stackback have no standalone LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file matching the inspected top-level patterns. This alone does not establish a distribution violation.
No Node deployed executable, Cocos editor/engine installation, generated engine bundle, WeChat runtime, OS/TLS/proxy/SBOM, GitHub Actions implementation or media rights were audited in this batch.
Literal JS import scan covers 125 files but is not an execution trace or formal complete module-resolution proof.

The npm network attempt was terminated without a captured response, so exact completed remote-request count cannot be asserted. The script uses only allowlisted public names/versions and fixed official registry, never credentials or npm configuration.
